title: The King Rejoices in the Lord's Strength

questions.question: O Lord, in your strength the king rejoices, and in your salvation how greatly he does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:1 (ESV): "O Lord, in your strength the king rejoices, and in your salvation how greatly he exults!"

questions.question: You have given him his heart's desire and have not withheld the request of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:2 (ESV): "You have given him his heart's desire and have not withheld the request of his lips."

questions.question: You met him with rich blessings; you set a crown of what on his head?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:3 (ESV): "...you set a crown of fine gold upon his head."

questions.question: He asked life of you; you gave it to him, length of days when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:4 (ESV): "...length of days forever and ever."

questions.question: For the king trusts in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:7 (ESV): "For the king trusts in the Lord..."

questions.question: Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:8 (ESV): "...your right hand will find out those who hate you."

questions.question: You will make them as a blazing what when you appear?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:9 (ESV): "You will make them as a blazing oven when you appear."

questions.question: The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and what will consume them?
You will destroy their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from among whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:10 (ESV): "...and their offspring from among the children of man."

questions.question: Be exalted, O Lord, in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:13 (ESV): "Be exalted, O Lord, in your strength! We will sing and praise your power."

questions.question: Though they plan evil against you, though they devise mischief, they will not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:11 (ESV): "...though they devise mischief, they will not succeed."

questions.question: For you will put them to flight; you will aim at their faces with your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:12 (ESV): "For you will put them to flight; you will aim at their faces with your bows."

questions.question: His glory is great through your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:5 (ESV): "His glory is great through your salvation; splendor and majesty you bestow on him."

questions.question: You make him most blessed forever; you make him glad with the joy of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 21:6 (ESV): "...you make him glad with the joy of your presence."

questions.question: And through the steadfast love of the Most High he shall not be what?

key_verse_text: Be exalted, O Lord, in your strength! We will sing and praise your power.
